english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: SK hynix reported record Q2 2026 results on July 29, 2026. Revenue 79.3187 trillion won, operating profit 60.5426 trillion won, net profit 93.9226 trillion won. Reuters reported the operating profit missed the LSEG SmartEstimate of 64 trillion won. Shares closed down 9.6% on July 29.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_changes: AI server products led price increases. HBM4 mass shipments began in Q2. SOCAMM2 sales grew. 1c DRAM shipments began. 321-layer NAND became the largest production share. The company finalized Long-Term Agreements with around 10 customers. Reuters reported these LTAs are typically five years and include deposits.
english_outline.section_3_expectations: Revenue and operating profit rose 257% and 557% year over year. Cash and cash equivalents reached 88 trillion won, up 33.6 trillion won quarter over quarter. Total debt fell 0.7 trillion won to 18.6 trillion won. Net cash reached 69.4 trillion won. Reuters reported the company plans to raise 2026 capital spending to the high-40 trillion won range from 30.2 trillion won in 2025. Analysts cited by Reuters said LTAs may temper near-term pricing gains.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing: Reuters reported shares closed down 9.6% and the KOSPI fell 6%. BNK Investment & Securities analyst Lee Min-hee cited concerns about tech infrastructure spending. DS Investment & Securities analyst Lee Su-rim said Samsung has greater pricing power. Meritz Securities analyst Kim Sunwoo said investors focus on cash deployment. Hyundai Motor Securities research head Greg Roh said a concrete shareholder return policy is needed.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation: HBM4 production ramp in the second half. M15X mass production schedule. Yongin Phase 1 cleanroom opening in early 2027. 321-layer NAND expansion to about 50% of domestic capacity by year-end. Disclosure of shareholder return plan later this year.

reader_questions: 公司官方新闻稿称第二季度营收、营业利润和净利润均创历史新高，但市场报道称业绩不及预期且股价大跌，这两个看似矛盾的表述应如何在同一分析中协调？
公司官方新闻稿将净利润率列为118%，这一比率高于营业利润率76%，其来源和含义是什么？是否应作为衡量核心盈利能力的指标？
公司官方新闻稿提到已与约10家客户敲定长期协议，市场报道称这类协议通常为期五年并包含押金等财务保障条款，这些协议对近期定价和收入确认的具体影响是什么？
checks: 核查结果：官方新闻稿确认营收79.3187万亿韩元、营业利润60.5426万亿韩元、净利润93.9226万亿韩元均为公司单季历史新高；市场报道确认营业利润低于LSEG SmartEstimate的64万亿韩元预测、营收低于84万亿韩元预测，且股价当日收跌9.6%、KOSPI收跌6%。两者并不矛盾：官方口径强调同比与环比创纪录，市场口径强调相对分析师预期和股价反应。修订稿应同时保留两组事实，并明确区分“创纪录”与“不及预期”的参照系。
核查结果：官方新闻稿确实列出净利润率118%，但该比率高于营业利润率76%，原因是净利润包含投资资产收益等非营业项目；市场报道引述净利润中包含63.3万亿韩元投资资产收益。因此118%的净利润率不能直接等同于核心经营盈利能力，修订稿应说明其构成，避免将其作为核心盈利指标单独强调。
核查结果：官方新闻稿确认已与约10家客户敲定长期协议并继续磋商；市场报道补充这类协议通常为期五年、包含押金等财务保障条款，并引述分析师观点称长期协议可能抑制近期存储价格上行空间。修订稿应保留协议期限与财务保障条款，并说明其对近期定价的潜在抑制作用，同时删除无来源支持的额外推断。
